main_text.head: DE LEGATIONE EVANGELICA AD INDOS CAPESSENDA.
CAPUT I.
Dominum postulare ut quamprimum propagetur regnum Christi inter Ethnicos Indos; paratumque esse ejus auxilium his qui se Sancto huic operi dicabunt.
main_text.p: Quum olim sub caeremoniali cultu, in expectatione Messiae esset Eccle-sia, regnum Dei tutelare & salutiferum arctis Iudaicae gentis limitibus circum-scribebatur: at postquam ille venit qui mit-tendus erat, & ruptis vinculis mortis in altum ascendit, ut dominaretur viventibus & mortuis, tunc diruta est maceria quae Ethnicos à communione foederis divini excludebat, atque ex utrisque factus
main_text.notes: The first letter of the body text is a large woodcut-style initial Q, joined to "uum" as "Quum". The running head is faint but legible. The faint mirrored text showing through the paper, visible in the middle and right of the page, is show-through and is not transcribed. The page ends mid-sentence at "factus" and continues on the next page.
